title: Universal Periodic Review (51st Session): Contribution of UNESCO to Compilation of UN Information - Sao Tome and Principe
why: Q1-Q2: states 'There is no legislation concerning freedom of information in Sao Tome and Principe' and recommends introducing an access to information law.

title: Sao Tome and Principe - 2025 Survey on Public Access to Information (SDG Indicator 16.10.2)
why: Q2-Q4: records 'No' for legal guarantee of access, information commission/commissioner and oversight; no law, regulation or functioning body identified.

title: Formacao da UNESCO Reforca Direito a Informacao em STP
why: Q1: reports training from 18 Oct 2023 to support drafting, adoption and implementation of an access law; law still at advocacy/adoption stage.

title: Legislacao STP Integridade
publisher: Centro de Integridade Publica de Sao Tome e Principe (CIP-STP)
why: Q1-Q3: says Lei n.o 5/2014 on the right to information is insufficient and without effective regulation, and a robust law with oversight body and sanctions is needed.

title: Sao Tome and Principe - 2024 Survey on Public Access to Information (SDG Indicator 16.10.2)
why: Q3-Q4: survey response ticks legal guarantee, information commission and request statistics for 2023 but no annual report; names no law, commissioner or numbers (contradicted by 2025 survey).

title: Sao Tome and Principe: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report
why: Q1-Q2: states there is no specific law guaranteeing public access to government information.

title: Representantes da Sociedade Civil pedem Acesso a Informacao e promocao da participacao
publisher: Centro de Integridade Publica de Sao Tome e Principe
why: Q1: records delivery on 1 Oct 2019 of a draft Lei de Acesso aos Documentos, Informacoes Administrativas e Promocao da Participacao Publica to the President of the National Assembly.

title: Report of the Working Group on the Universal Periodic Review: Sao Tome and Principe
why: Q1-Q2: recommendations 106.59 and 106.60 urge introducing an access to information law, so none existed in 2021.
